Calgary, Alberta--(Newsfile Corp. - October 30, 2026) - West High Yield (W.H.Y.) Resources Ltd. (TSXV: WHY) (FSE: W0H) ("West High Yield" or the "Company") is pleased to announce a non-brokered private placement offering for the sale of up to 4,814,815 units of the Company (the "Units") at a price of CAD$0.27 per Unit for aggregate gross proceeds of up to CAD$1,300,000.00 (the "Offering").

Each Unit issued under the Offering will consist of one (1) common share of the Company (each, a "Common Share") and one half (1/2) of one (1) Common Share purchase warrant (each, a "Warrant"). Each full Warrant, together with CAD$0.37, will entitle the holder thereof to acquire one (1) additional Common Share for a period of twelve (12) months from its date of issuance. The Warrants will not be listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (the "TSXV").

The Company may pay a finder's fee in connection with the Offering to eligible finders in accordance with the policies of the TSXV and applicable Canadian securities laws consisting of: (i) a cash commission of up to 6% of the gross proceeds of the Offering; and (ii) common share purchase warrants (the "Finder's Warrants") of up to 6% of the number of full Warrants issued under the Offering. The Finder's Warrants will have identical terms to the Warrants.

The Offering will be completed pursuant to certain exemptions from the prospectus requirements under applicable Canadian securities laws. All securities issued under the Offering are subject to a statutory hold period from their date of issue in accordance with applicable Canadian securities laws. None of the Units, Common Shares or Warrants will be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and none may be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements.

The proceeds from the Offering will be used to cover essential operations and general working capital purposes and expenses. The Offering is subject to certain closing conditions including, but not limited to, the receipt of all necessary approvals, including the acceptance and approval of the TSXV.

About West High Yield

West High Yield is a publicly traded junior mining exploration and development company, established in 2003, and focused on acquiring, exploring, and developing mineral resource properties in Canada. Its primary objective is to develop its Record Ridge critical mineral (magnesium, silica, nickel, and iron) deposit using green processing techniques to minimize waste and CO2 emissions.

The Company's Record Ridge critical mineral deposit located 10 kilometers southwest of Rossland, British Columbia has approximately 10.6 million tonnes of contained magnesium based on an independently produced National Instrument 43-101 - Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects ("NI 43-101") Preliminary Economic Assessment technical report (titled "Revised NI 43-101 Technical Report Preliminary Economic Assessment Record Ridge Project, British Columbia, Canada") prepared by SRK Consulting (Canada) Inc. on April 18, 2013 in accordance with NI 43-101 and which can be found on the Company's profile at https://www.sedarplus.ca.

NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Please replace the release dated October 29, 2026 with the following corrected version to add the Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements paragraph at the end of the release.

Step-by-step process of how to redeem American Express Reward Dollars for a deposit into a High Yield Savings Account (HYSA) in the Amex Mobile App

The updated release reads:

American Express Connects Cash Back to High Yield Savings Accounts and Business Checking Accounts

  • U.S. Consumer Cash Back1 Card Members can now redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit into an American Express® High Yield Savings Account, and watch their savings grow with a competitive Annual Percentage Yield.
  • U.S. Business Cash Back Card Members can also now redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit into an American Express® Business Checking account.

Today, American Express introduced a new way for eligible U.S. Consumer and Business Cash Back Card Members to redeem rewards for a deposit into eligible American Express bank accounts, creating a more integrated experience across their Card and banking products and giving customers more options in how to redeem the rewards they earn.

U.S. Consumer Cash Back Card Members can now redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit directly into an American Express® High Yield Savings Account (HYSA), helping turn rewards into compounded growth2. Graphite™ Business Cash Unlimited Card Members can also now redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit into an American Express Business Checking account.

“Card Members want their rewards to be useful, flexible, and easy to put toward the things that matter most to them,” said Corey Timlin, Senior Vice President of Consumer Banking at American Express. “With the majority of our deposits coming from existing Card Members, we have a unique opportunity to bring Cards and banking closer together. By making it possible for Card Members to turn the rewards they earn into savings and everyday banking, we’re creating a more connected experience that helps them get even more value from their relationship with American Express.”

A More Connected Membership Experience for Cash Back Card Members

  • For U.S. Consumer Cash Back Card Members, Reward Dollars can now be redeemed for a deposit directly into an Amex HYSA at a 1:1 redemption rate. Once deposited, those funds can earn the account’s competitive APY with daily compounding interest which is deposited monthly.
  • For example, Blue Cash Preferred® Card Members can earn an industry-leading 6% cash back at U.S. supermarkets on up to $6,000 in purchases per year and on select U.S. streaming subscriptions then redeem those Reward Dollars for deposits directly into an Amex HYSA with a competitive APY.
  • For Graphite™ Business Cash Unlimited Card Members, Reward Dollars can now be redeemed for a deposit directly into an Amex Business Checking Account at a 1:1 redemption rate.
  • In 2027, American Express plans to introduce an additional feature that will give Consumer Card Members who also have an American Express HYSA the ability to automatically redeem Reward Dollars for deposits into their account.

How to Redeem Cash Back Reward Dollars for Deposits into an Amex High Yield Savings Account or a Business Checking Account

Redeeming Reward Dollars for a deposit into an Amex High Yield Savings Account or Amex Business Checking account takes just a few simple steps through an American Express online account, with redemption through the Amex App coming soon. Here’s how:

  • Log in to your American Express account online.
  • Select your eligible Cash Back Card and navigate to your Reward Dollars.
  • Choose the option to redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit into your American Express HYSA (for U.S. Consumer Cash Back Card Members) or Business Checking Account (for U.S. Business Cash Back Card Members).
  • Enter the amount of Reward Dollars you'd like to redeem for a deposit. There is no minimum redemption amount.
  • Review and confirm your redemption of Reward Dollars for a deposit directly into your HYSA or Business Checking Account (as applicable), where you can begin earning interest.

Both U.S. Consumer Cash Back and Business Card Members can also continue to redeem Reward Dollars for statement credits and toward eligible purchases at Amazon.com checkout.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 30, 2026) - Valkea Resources Corp. (TSXV: OZ) (OTCQB: OZBKF) (FSE: 4A7) (the "Company" or "Valkea") announces that the board of directors of the Company has adopted an advance notice policy (the "Advance Notice Policy").

The purpose of the Advance Notice Policy is to establish a process that provides shareholders, directors and management of the Company with direction on the nomination of directors. This Advance Notice Policy is the framework by which the Company seeks to fix a deadline by which holders of record of common shares of the Company must submit director nominations to the Company prior to any annual or special meeting of shareholders and sets forth the information that a shareholder must include in the notice to the Company for the notice to be in proper written form.

For all subsequent meetings of shareholders of the Company, the notice of a shareholder nominating a director (the "Nominating Shareholder") to the Corporate Secretary of the Company must be made:

  • in the case of an annual meeting of shareholders, not less than 30 days prior to the date of the annual meeting of shareholders; provided, however, that in the event that the annual meeting of shareholders is to be held on a date that is less than 50 days after the date (the "Notice Date") on which the first public announcement of the date of the annual meeting was made, notice by the Nominating Shareholder may be made not later than the close of business on the tenth (10th) day following the Notice Date in respect of such meeting; or
  • in the case of a special meeting (which is not also an annual meeting) of shareholders called for the purpose of electing directors (whether or not called for other purposes), not later than the close of business on the fifteenth (15th) day following the day on which the first public announcement of the date of the special meeting of shareholders was made.

The Advance Notice Policy is effective immediately. At the next annual meeting of shareholders, the Company is seeking shareholder approval and ratification of the Advance Notice Policy. In the event that shareholders determine not to ratify the Advance Notice Policy by ordinary resolution, the Advance Notice Policy shall terminate and be void and of no further force and effect following the termination of the meeting.

The full text of the Advance Notice Policy is available via SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca or upon request by contacting Ota Hally, the Chief Financial Officer of the Company by e-mail at ohally@valkearesources.com. Further details on the Meeting and the Advance Notice Policy will be contained in a management information circular to be mailed to shareholders of the Company in connection with the next annual meeting of shareholders (the "Management Information Circular"). The Management Information Circular will also be available on SEDAR+.

Stock Option Grant

The Company also announces that it has granted an aggregate of 200,000 incentive stock options (the "Options") to an employee of the Company, to purchase up to 200,000 common shares ("Option Shares") in the capital of Valkea. The Options are exercisable at a price of $0.27 per share for a period of five (5) years from the date of grant, subject to vesting provisions. The Options will vest over two years, one third at grant, and one-third vesting every twelve months thereafter, in accordance with the Company's approved omnibus plan.

The Company believes that the issuance of these Options will further align the interests of its team with those of shareholders and will serve as an incentive for continued performance and commitment to the Company's growth.

About Valkea

Valkea Resources is a geoscience-led exploration company focused on making new gold and base metals discoveries in Northern Finlandʼs prospective Central Lapland Greenstone Belt. Its 350 km2 land package includes six principal project areas that span highly prospective regional geological structures. The Company's leadership and technical team include key contributors to the multimillion-ounce Ikkari gold discovery made in 2020. Work is underway to make a new discovery using the same systematic and disciplined approach to identifying targets with the best potential for meaningful size and the possibility of becoming mines of the future.

Represented claimants make up a growing share of participation, accounting for 41% of claims submitted through the Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program.

ROSEMEAD, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- October saw the highest number of claims submitted this year to Southern California Edison’s Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program, as community members directly impacted by the Eaton Fire continue to evaluate their options for seeking compensation ahead of the Nov. 30, 2026, claim submission deadline. The record month builds on increasing claim activity in recent months. More than 41% of claims have now been submitted through an attorney or authorized representative.

“It’s encouraging to see more families and businesses turning to the program as they recover and move forward,” said Pedro J. Pizarro, president and CEO of Edison International, SCE’s parent company. “There is still time to submit a claim before the November 30 deadline, and we encourage eligible community members to explore what compensation may be available to them.”

The program is designed to provide compensation in line with settlement values for similar claims in past wildfire lawsuits through a more streamlined approach. As of Oct. 30, 2026:

  • More than 5,550 claims submitted, consisting of nearly 17,000 individuals, trusts and legal entities, with 41% submitted by attorneys or authorized representatives.
  • More than 3,200 offers extended to over 8,000 claimants, totaling about $1.1 billion. Nearly 80% of offers have been accepted, with more pending. Only about 2% of offers have been declined.
  • More than 4,450 claimants paid, totaling over $625 million, with many more in process.

Get The Facts

It is important that eligible community members make fully informed decisions based on accurate facts. For anyone who has been told that waiting for the first trial date will provide compensation on a similar timeline or within months of the Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program deadline, that is false. Resolution through litigation will be lengthy. Only eight households have been selected by the court to participate in the initial trial.

Participation in the Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program results in a timely, no-commitment offer and still keeps the option open to pursue the longer litigation path if desired. Claims submitted by Nov. 30 will continue to be reviewed and processed afterward, even if validation or preparation of an offer has not been completed. Submitting a claim, receiving an offer and evaluating that offer do not waive a claimant’s rights.

More Represented Claimants Turning to the Program

Claimants represented by attorneys are increasingly participating in the Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program. For claimants represented at the time they submit a claim, offers include an additional 20% of the net damages portion to help address legal expenses.

Angela Loera, who lost her home in the Eaton Fire, is among those who participated in the program with the assistance of an attorney. Her attorney, Derek Whitefield, has helped hundreds of claimants navigate the program.

“Thank you for making this process easy, quick and seamless,” said Loera in a handwritten note shared with SCE.

Fair Offers, Fast Payments

Litigation may take years. Some claims arising from 2017 and 2018 fires remain pending today. The Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program offers a more streamlined alternative, with offers and payments measured in weeks or months rather than years. To keep this option available, claims must be submitted by Nov. 30, 2026, and claimants must remain responsive to requests for information and communications related to their claim.

  • On average, offers are being delivered within 36 days following submission of a substantially complete claim.
  • Payments are made within 30 days after all conditions in the settlement agreement have been satisfied, with many claimants receiving payment in as little as two to three weeks.

Learn More and Get Help Starting a Claim

SCE will host in-person and virtual sessions where community members can learn about the program, ask questions and receive help starting a claim. Register here for the following sessions:

  • Thursday, Nov. 12, 6 p.m. (Westminster Presbyterian Church, 1757 N. Lake Ave., Pasadena)
  • Thursday, Nov. 19, 6 p.m. (virtual)

To submit a claim and access detailed guidance in English and Spanish, visit the Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program web page. One-on-one assistance is available in multiple languages by phone or in person, from start to finish. Call 888-912-8528 to get started.

About Southern California Edison

An Edison International (NYSE: EIX) company, Southern California Edison is one of the nation’s largest electric utilities, serving a population of approximately 15 million via 5 million customer accounts in a 50,000-square-mile service area within Central, Coastal and Southern California.

Financing Flexibility to Support Execution
EON has filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) covering 20 million shares of common stock in connection with its previously announced $150 million equity line of credit with White Lion. Management recognizes that issuing shares poses a potential dilution risk to existing ownership. The Company's capital management strategy is designed to balance equity costs against the potential returns of drilling and strategic acquisitions, while prudently evaluating debt financing alternatives where appropriate to maximize underlying value per share.

Asset Portfolio and Defined Development Agenda

  • San Andres Formation: The Company's primary focus is the development of the San Andres formation interval in the Grayburg-Jackson Field utilizing horizontal drilling. Management previously estimated that successful development of this interval could ultimately contribute approximately $95 million in future Proved Developed Producing (PDP) PV-10 value to the Company. The initial phase of the San Andres development program is estimated to require a capital investment of approximately $15 million to $25 million for EON's proportionate share. These estimates remain subject to final financing, drilling performance, commodity prices, supply costs, and other operational variables. The projected value does not currently constitute established SEC-qualified PDP reserves.
  • South Justis Unit: The South Justis Unit presents a secondary avenue for

growth, including potential horizontal development in the Yesos formation. While management believes this asset holds meaningful potential, the timing, scope, and quantification of value creation remain subject to thorough technical validation, economic results, and capital availability.

Prospective Capital Allocation Benchmark
The Company has established a prospective capital allocation objective to target adding at least $2 in additional PDP PV-10 reserve value through drilling, development, and acquisitions for every new share of common stock issued. Management emphasizes that this target is a prospective capital allocation benchmark used for investment underwriting and project evaluation. It does not constitute a forecast of financial performance, a commitment to return $2 in cash per share to stockholders, a stock price forecast, or a guarantee that equity dilution will be fully offset.

Achieving this PV-10 target depends on multiple variables, including final financing terms, the volume and pricing of shares issued, prevailing commodity prices, formal engineering reserve estimates, future development and operating costs, and the successful conversion of non-producing opportunities into proved developed producing reserves. Stockholders should assess the Company's progress based on actual reported reserves, audited production metrics, and GAAP cash flows.

Strategic Priorities
EON's operational priorities include securing appropriately structured capital, advancing its top-tier drilling opportunities, executing disciplined underwriting on potential acquisitions, and maintaining transparent communication of operational milestones. Management intends to measure its upcoming progress through tangible data points, including well results, formal reserve assessments, capital efficiency, and overall production output.

BETA’s ALIA CTOL (CX300) aircraft flew nearly 700 nautical miles in Florida, including the route of the world’s first scheduled airline flight

BETA is flying as a partner in the eIPP project led by the Florida Department of Transportation, one of eight selected nationwide

SOUTH BURLINGTON, Vt. & TAMPA BAY, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--BETA Technologies (NYSE: BETA) (“BETA”), an aerospace and defense company, has completed 14 flights across Florida, covering nearly 700 nautical miles, under the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and U.S. Department of Transportation (U.S. DOT) Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing and Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). BETA is a partner in Florida’s eIPP project, alongside lead participant Florida Department of Transportation, Republic Airways, Brickyard Connection and Metro Aviation. BETA’s conventional fixed-wing electric aircraft, the ALIA CTOL, has flown across the Orlando and Tampa regions, including routes from St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport (KPIE) and Albert Whitted Airport (KSPG) to Tampa International Airport (KTPA).

“The eIPP lets us fly electric aircraft in the National Airspace System alongside our customers to evaluate how the aircraft perform in real-world operations,” said Kyle Clark, founder and chief executive officer of BETA. “ALIA is all-electric and mechanically simple, so it’s inexpensive to operate and maintain, and we built the charging network in parallel. Florida invested early, and our chargers are now at nine sites from the Panhandle to the Space Coast. Earlier this year, the aircraft and the network together supported high-cadence operations with Republic Airways along the I-4 corridor, up to nine flights a day at under $17 in energy per flight. We’ve logged more than 250,000 nautical miles across our CTOL and VTOL fleet to get here. The eIPP is where we put that experience to work, on the routes our customers will fly in commercial service.”

BETA’s flights from Albert Whitted Airport in St. Petersburg to Tampa International follow the route of the world’s first scheduled commercial airline flight, which Tony Jannus flew in 1914.

“Florida is helping safely integrate these new aircraft into the airspace system and prove that the next great era of American aviation is already here,” said FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford. “Each flight provides crucial data and lessons learned that will help establish safety standards for everyday operations.”

“More than 100 years ago, Florida helped launch the commercial aviation industry. Today, we are helping shape the next era of flight,” said Florida Department of Transportation Secretary Jared W. Perdue, P.E. “Through strategic investments, statewide planning, and partnerships with some of the industry’s top innovators, Florida is creating the infrastructure and policies needed to safely integrate Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) into our transportation system. These flights demonstrate how we are turning vision into reality.”

Earlier this year, BETA signed an agreement with the Florida Department of Transportation to supply 34 chargers and thermal management systems. Florida is home to BETA’s largest charging network in the U.S., with chargers currently online at nine sites:

  • Bob Sikes Airport (KCEW)
  • Duke Field (KEGI)
  • Tallahassee International Airport (KTLH)
  • Jacksonville Executive at Craig Airport (KCRG)
  • Gainesville Regional Airport (KGNV)
  • Tampa International Airport (KTPA)
  • SunTrax Advanced Air Mobility Facility
  • Kissimmee Gateway Airport (KISM)
  • Space Coast Regional Airport (KTIX)

BETA’s chargers are multimodal and interoperable, and designed to integrate with existing airport infrastructure. They are UL-certified and use the Combined Charging System (CCS) standard, so any CCS-compliant electric vehicle, in the air or on the ground, can charge at a BETA site.

“We believed in Kyle Clark and his team long before most people understood what electric aviation could mean for our industry,” said Todd Stanberry, vice president and co-owner of Metro Aviation. “What I love about these demonstrations is that we’re not just talking about the possibilities anymore. We’re seeing them happen. Whether it’s moving passengers, cargo or patients, BETA continues to show us why we believed in them from day one.”

BETA’s ALIA family includes the ALIA CTOL and an electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft (the ALIA VTOL), built for passenger, cargo, medical, emergency response, and defense missions.

Florida is the host of BETA’s last eIPP kickoff event. BETA is participating in seven of the eight programs selected by the FAA and U.S. DOT, which together span 26 states, including Virginia, Maryland, Louisiana, Texas, North Carolina, Utah, New York, Vermont and now Florida. Across these programs, BETA, its customers and state and local partners are flying electric aircraft in real operating environments, integrating them into the National Airspace System (NAS) and generating the operational data the FAA and U.S. DOT need to shape the rules for safe, routine commercial service.

All-New Polaris-Engineered RZR Pro R Factory Boost Delivers 400 Horsepower and Purpose-Built Enhancements for Open Desert Racing, Joining the RZR Pro R Factory in Polaris' Race Machine Lineup Available for Purchase

MINNEAPOLIS, Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Polaris and RZR Factory Racing today unveiled the all-new RZR Pro R Factory Boost at the company's annual Camp RZR event at Glamis Imperial Sand Dunes. Delivering up to 400 horsepower, the RZR Pro R Factory Boost is designed and developed by Polaris engineers and built in Roseau, Minnesota, bringing a bigger, stronger and even more capable package to the race-proven platform.

Joining rather than replacing the existing Gen 2 RZR Pro R Factory, the new model gives racers another purpose-built option with a different level of performance and capability. Together, the two platforms strengthen Polaris' race vehicle lineup and its commitment to delivering race-ready side-by-sides designed to rule every race.

The RZR Pro R Factory Boost builds on the foundation established by the recently introduced production RZR Pro R Boost while incorporating proven components and lessons learned from the Gen 2 RZR Pro R Factory. Engineered specifically for competition, the new race machine further refines power delivery, chassis design, cooling and suspension to meet the demands of high-speed desert racing.

"The Gen 2 RZR Pro R Factory has proven itself as the benchmark in the side-by-side category and demonstrated our ability to compete among the best, beating all other UTVs in virtually every major offroad race in the world. With the RZR Pro R Factory Boost, we're building on that success with a clear goal: to keep pushing the boundaries of performance and give our team and customers every advantage to continue winning at the highest level," said Alex Scheuerell, Polaris' Director of Off-Road Motorsports. "Desert racing demands strength, speed and durability across hundreds of miles, and we've engineered this platform to take on the next level of competition. We're ready to put it to the test and push for results that reflect the ambition of our team."

The RZR Pro R Factory Boost includes the following race modifications:

  • Turbocharged Power – A race-tuned, turbocharged ProStar Fury 2.0L four-cylinder engine delivers up to 400 horsepower for commanding holeshots, high-speed passes, and the power to attack demanding terrain.
  • Performance Race-Spec Chassis – The reinforced chassis features a wheelbase extended by 6.5 inches to a total of 111 inches, for greater straight-line stability and control over rough terrain. Increased tubing size across key structural members adds strength and stiffness to support higher speeds and the demands of desert racing.
  • Competition-Ready Cockpit and Cage – Redesigned with driver feedback in mind, the all-new cage design delivers added strength, while a cab that's two inches wider provides more cockpit space for improved comfort and legroom. The expanded design transforms the feel from a traditional side-by-side to a purpose-built race car.
  • Full Carbon Fiber Bodywork with Aerodynamic Design – Sculpted carbon fiber bodywork and an arched roofline reduce weight and improve aerodynamic efficiency at high speeds. Polaris engineers used computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to model airflow at speeds exceeding 100 mph, informing the cage shape and redesigned rear body profile to optimize airflow and support high-speed desert racing performance.
  • Upgraded Fuel System – A 45-gallon (170-liter) fuel cell increases capacity over the previous-generation RZR Pro R Factory's 34-gallon system, extending its range beyond 200 miles to reduce pit stops.
  • MoTeC Components – The fully integrated MoTeC electronics package features an upgraded M150 ECU and dual power distribution modules, adding a second PDM over the Gen 2 RZR Pro R Factory for expanded power distribution and control capabilities.
  • Race-Tuned DYNAMIX DV Suspension – Three-inch internal bypass DYNAMIX DV Live Valve shocks feature race-specific components and upgraded one-inch shock shafts for increased strength and a broader dynamic range. Race-specific tuning maintains control across changing terrain, while a standard FOX steering damper absorbs large impacts to improve steering control and driver confidence at high speeds.

The RZR Pro R Factory Boost is available to order now in limited quantities through SCI Distribution, LLC, an exclusive distributor, with the first order window closing February 15, 2027. Starting at $200,000 US MSRP, the new race machine will be offered alongside the continued availability of the championship-proven RZR Pro R Factory, giving racers two platforms to choose from based on their performance needs and racing goals. Polaris will produce the RZR Pro R Factory Boost with SCI managing the sales and post-sale customer support process.

For the complete list of race-focused upgrades and technical specifications, or to submit an inquiry for purchase, visit https://www.polaris.com/en-us/off-road/rzr/models/rzr-pro-r-factory-boost/ 

The RZR Factory Racing team will debut the new RZR Pro R Factory Boost race machine at the 2027 King of The Hammers event, competing in multiple races.

To learn more about Polaris and the production RZR Pro R Boost, please visit Polaris.com/RZR or join the conversation and follow on Facebook sm, Instagram sm, YouTube sm and Xsm.

As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) has been defining and redefining outdoor adventure since 1954. Polaris delivers industry-shaping off-road vehicles, snowmobiles, boats, military, quadricycles, and commercial transportation vehicles, along with an expansive portfolio of parts, garments, and accessories. Its lineup includes some of the most iconic brands in powersports including the RANGER, RZR, Polaris XPEDITION, Bennington pontoons, Slingshot, and more.
